references.title: Formula Retail Storefront Design
references.locator: Storefront Components and Formula Retail Storefront Design
observations: Storefront bays distinguish piers, bulkheads, glazing, transoms and entrances.
Retain historic components when inserting chain identity; a brand does not imply a replacement building shell.

references.title: Odin shampoo unit
references.location: Product reference; dimensions remain inference priors
observations: A contoured reclining seat and tilting bowl form a coordinated backwash unit.
Basin and chair need to remain aligned; styling chairs are a separate product type.

references.title: Salon stations and cabinetry look book
references.location: Product reference; dimensions remain inference priors
observations: Styling stations pair mirrors with work surfaces and storage.
Shampoo storage includes towel and hamper provision; these are functional zones rather than decorative boxes.

references.title: THE ONE integrated salon station
references.location: Product reference; dimensions remain inference priors
observations: Integrated equipment exists, but a generic salon is not assumed to use that proprietary product.
Rendered independent stations retain coordinated chair, mirror, worktop and stylist space.
